content: Shopify POS supports both discount codes (created in admin, entered/scanned at POS checkout) and manual/staff-applied line-item or order-level discounts (percentage or fixed amount) gated behind an 'Apply custom discounts' staff permission. Square and Loyverse follow the same two-track pattern: promo/discount codes for self-serve or campaign use, plus a permissioned manual discount button for cashier judgment calls (damaged goods, goodwill). The data model separates a Discount definition (code, type, value, scope) from a DiscountApplication/line-item record capturing which staff member applied it and to which line or order.
